f91a8dc336.q: What is the 90-10 rule in leadership that John Harbaugh applies with the New York Giants?
f91a8dc336.a: John Harbaugh's 90-10 rule focuses 90 percent of managerial attention on the 90 percent of things an employee does really well, giving them praise and positioning them to utilize their strengths, while reserving 10 percent of attention for critical feedback on areas needing improvement. This approach creates an environment where employees trust leadership enough to accept coaching and raise their own standards, as exemplified by Ray Lewis who would ask to be coached harder because the positive foundation was so strong.

e03106e646.q: What specific content strategy did Bobby Maximus recommend for social media growth?
e03106e646.a: Bobby Maximus recommended shooting 100 long-form videos within one year on subjects you know more about than the common person, then plugging them into Opus to chop them up into 15 or 20 short-form videos and posting every day. Long-form for social media means anything longer than five minutes focused on your specific expertise, whether that's combine coaching or weight loss specialization.

efa53ea135.q: What did Tony Smith teach about reframing focus after setbacks through his son's baseball example?
efa53ea135.a: Tony Smith described how his son recalibrates after a strikeout by running back to the dugout and immediately cheering for the next batter, demonstrating that you cannot be negative and positive at the same time. This principle applies to business too—when marketing campaigns fail or team conversations go poorly, doing something to gain positive momentum like completing an effective workout or sending another marketing email is the best cure for negativity.
